title: Esse tuzilmasi: kirish, dalil, xulosa
goal_uz: Dars oxirida tezis gapi yozasiz, PEEL bo‘yicha asosiy abzats tuzasiz, abzatslarni bog‘laysiz va takrorsiz xulosa yozib, 250 so‘zli fikr bildirish essesini rejalashtira olasiz.

scenes.title: Esse tuzilmasi
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ijtimoiy muammolar haqida gapirdik, sabab, oqibat va yechimni bog‘ladik. Bugun shu fikrlarni qog‘ozga tushirishni o‘rganamiz. Asosiy maqsad: tezis gapi yozish, abzatsni to‘g‘ri tuzish, abzatslarni bir-biriga bog‘lash va xulosani takrorsiz yozish. Dars oxirida 250 so‘zli fikr-mulohaza essesini mustaqil rejalashtira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last lesson you spoke about social problems. Today you will learn how to put your ideas on paper: a clear thesis, strong paragraphs, smooth links and a conclusion that adds something new.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ijtimoiy muammolar haqida gapirdingiz. Bugun fikrlaringizni qog‘ozga tushirasiz: aniq tezis, kuchli abzatslar, silliq bog‘lanish va yangi narsa qo‘shadigan xulosa.

scenes.title: Essening umumiy shakli
scenes.say_native: 250 so‘zli essening klassik shakli to‘rt abzatsdan iborat: kirish, ikkita asosiy abzats va xulosa. Taxminiy taqsimot: kirish va xulosa 50 so‘zdan, har bir asosiy abzats 75 so‘zdan. Har bir abzatsning o‘z vazifasi bor, shuning uchun ularni aralashtirmang. O‘zbekcha insholarda ko‘pincha uzun kirish yoziladi, inglizcha esse esa ancha to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri: o‘quvchi birinchi abzatsdayoq sizning fikringizni bilishi kerak.
scenes.say: A 250-word opinion essay usually has four paragraphs: an introduction, two body paragraphs and a conclusion. Each paragraph has one job.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr bildirish essesida odatda to‘rt abzats bo‘ladi: kirish, ikkita asosiy abzats va xulosa. Har bir abzatsning bitta vazifasi bor.

scenes.title: Tezis gapi nima?
board: Thesis statement = your position + main reasons
One clear sentence, at the end of the introduction

examples.t: Governments should ban single-use plastics because they harm wildlife and are easy to replace.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar bir martalik plastikni taqiqlashi kerak, chunki u tabiatga zarar beradi va uni almashtirish oson.

scenes.say_native: Tezis gapi — esseni boshqarib turadigan eng muhim gap. U sizning pozitsiyangizni, yaxshisi asosiy sabablaringizni bildiradi. Odatda kirish abzatsining oxirida keladi. Tezis tayyor bo‘lsa, qolgan abzatslar o‘zi shakllanadi: har bir sabab bitta asosiy abzatsga aylanadi. Tezis bo‘lmasa, esse tarqoq fikrlar to‘plamiga aylanadi va o‘qituvchi sizning nima demoqchi ekaningizni topa olmaydi.
scenes.say: The thesis statement is the most important sentence in the essay. It tells the reader your position and, ideally, your main reasons.
scenes.say_uz: Tezis gapi esseni boshqaradi. U pozitsiyangizni va asosiy sabablaringizni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Zaif va kuchli tezis
board: ✗ This essay is about social media.
✗ Social media is good and bad.
✓ Social media does more harm than good because it damages concentration and spreads false information.
scenes.say_native: Uchta variantni solishtiring. Birinchisi — faqat mavzu, pozitsiya yo‘q. Ikkinchisi — “yaxshi ham, yomon ham”, bu ham pozitsiya emas. Uchinchisi esa haqiqiy tezis: aniq fikr, “does more harm than good”, va ikkita sabab. Savol bering: kimdir bu gapga “yo‘q, rozi emasman” deya oladimi? Agar ha, demak u bahslashsa bo‘ladigan, ya’ni kuchli tezis.
scenes.say: Compare. This essay is about social media is only a topic. Social media is good and bad has no clear position. Social media does more harm than good, because it damages concentration and spreads false information, is a real thesis.
scenes.say_uz: Solishtiring. Birinchisi faqat mavzu. Ikkinchisida aniq pozitsiya yo‘q. Uchinchisi haqiqiy tezis: fikr va ikki sabab.

scenes.title: Tezis formulasi
board: I firmly believe that … because … and …

examples.t: I firmly believe that public libraries remain essential because they offer equal access to information and bring communities together.
examples.uz: Men qat’iy ishonamanki, jamoat kutubxonalari muhim bo‘lib qolmoqda, chunki ular axborotga teng kirish beradi va jamoani birlashtiradi.

scenes.say_native: Oddiy formula: mavzu, pozitsiya va ikkita sabab. Tayyor boshlanishlar: “I firmly believe that …”, “This essay will argue that …”, “In my view, …”. Sabablarni “because” yoki “since” bilan bog‘lang va ikkala sababni parallel tuzing: ikkalasi ham ot, yoki ikkalasi ham fe’l bo‘lsin. Rasmiy esselarda “I” ni haddan ziyod ishlatmang, fikr bildirish esselarida esa bir-ikki marta ruxsat etiladi.
scenes.say: A simple formula: topic plus position plus two reasons. Use phrases like I firmly believe that, this essay will argue that, or in my view.
scenes.say_uz: Formula: mavzu, pozitsiya va ikkita sabab. Foydalaning: I firmly believe that, this essay will argue that, in my view.

scenes.title: Tezisdagi xatolar
board: ✗ In this essay I am going to talk about …
✗ Do you think homework is useful?
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “I am going to talk about …” — bu e’lon, fikr emas. Ikkinchisi: tezisni savol shaklida yozish: savol pozitsiya bildirmaydi. Uchinchisi: “Everybody agrees …” kabi mutlaq da’vo, chunki o‘quvchi bu bilan rozi emas. To‘g‘risi: aniq fikr va sabab, masalan, “Homework should be reduced because it limits family time and creativity”. Yozma inglizchada gapni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri boshlash yaxshi uslub.
scenes.say: Avoid announcements like I am going to talk about. Do not ask questions as your thesis. And do not claim that everybody agrees. State your position.
scenes.say_uz: E’lonlardan saqlaning. Savolni tezis qilmang. Hamma rozi demang. Pozitsiyangizni ayting.

scenes.title: Tezisni yaxshilang
board: 1) This essay is about mobile phones.
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif tezisni tuzating. Birinchisi — mavzu, ikkinchisi — savol, uchinchisi — pozitsiyasiz gap. Har biriga aniq fikr va ikkita sabab qo‘shing. Masalan, birinchisini “Mobile phones should be banned in classrooms because …” deb boshlash mumkin. Qog‘ozga yozing yoki baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Improve these three weak theses. Add a clear position and two reasons to each one.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta zaif tezisni yaxshilang. Har biriga aniq pozitsiya va ikkita sabab qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Mobile phones should be banned in class because they distract students and reduce face-to-face learning.
2) Online learning is effective because it is flexible and affordable.
3) City life is beneficial because of jobs and services, despite the noise.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin javoblar. Birinchi: telefonlar sinfda taqiqlanishi kerak, chunki ular o‘quvchilarni chalg‘itadi. Ikkinchi: onlayn ta’lim samarali, chunki moslashuvchan va arzon. Uchinchi: shahar hayoti foydali, garchi shovqin bo‘lsa-da. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiysi, har birida pozitsiya va sabab bor. Sabablar o‘xshash tuzilishda bo‘lsa, gap silliq o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: Possible answers. Mobile phones should be banned in class because they distract students. Online learning is effective because it is flexible and affordable. City life is beneficial despite the noise.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javoblar. Telefonlar sinfda taqiqlanishi kerak, chunki chalg‘itadi. Onlayn ta’lim samarali, chunki moslashuvchan va arzon. Shahar hayoti shovqinga qaramay foydali.

scenes.title: Kirish abzatsi: uch qism
scenes.say_native: Kirish abzatsi uch qismdan iborat. Birinchi: mavzuni kengroq kontekstga qo‘yadigan umumiy gap. Ikkinchi: savolni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta aytish, ya’ni paraphrase. Uchinchi: tezis. Savolni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang, bu nega ball yo‘qotadi: imtihon sizning lug‘at boyligingizni ko‘rmoqchi. Shuningdek “Nowadays …” va “Since the beginning of time …” kabi eskirgan boshlanishlardan qoching.
scenes.say: An introduction has three parts: a general statement to set the scene, a paraphrase of the question, and your thesis. Do not copy the question word for word.
scenes.say_uz: Kirish uch qismdan iborat: umumiy gap, savolning parafrazasi va tezis. Savolni ko‘chirmang.

scenes.title: To‘liq kirish
board: Question: Should university education be free?
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘liq kirish. Birinchi gap umumiy kontekst: oilalar oliy ta’lim narxidan qiynalmoqda. Ikkinchi gap savolning parafrazasi: o‘qish haqini davlat to‘lashi kerakmi, degan muhokama. Uchinchi gap tezis: universitet bepul bo‘lishi kerak, chunki imkoniyatni kengaytiradi va iqtisodni mustahkamlaydi. Ko‘ryapsizmi, savoldagi “free” so‘zi “paid by the state” deb o‘zgartirilgan.
scenes.say: More and more families struggle with the cost of higher education. Whether tuition should be paid by the state is therefore widely debated. I firmly believe that university should be free, because it widens opportunity and strengthens the economy.
scenes.say_uz: Tobora ko‘proq oilalar oliy ta’lim narxidan qiynalmoqda. O‘qish haqini davlat to‘lashi kerakmi, degan savol shuning uchun keng muhokama qilinadi. Men universitet bepul bo‘lishi kerak deb qat’iy ishonaman, chunki u imkoniyatni kengaytiradi va iqtisodni mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.title: Asosiy abzats: PEEL
board: L: Link back to the thesis
scenes.say_native: Asosiy abzatsni PEEL usulida quring. P — Point, ya’ni mavzu gapi: abzatsning bitta asosiy fikri. E — Explanation, bu fikrni izohlash: nega bu to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchi E — Example yoki dalil. L — Link, ya’ni abzatsni tezisga qaytarish. Bir abzats — bitta fikr. Agar ikkinchi fikr paydo bo‘lsa, uni yangi abzatsga ko‘chiring. Bu qoida O‘zbekistonda yozilgan insholarga qaraganda qattiqroq, lekin ingliz o‘quvchisi buni kutadi.
scenes.say: A body paragraph can follow PEEL: Point, Explanation, Example and Link. One paragraph, one main idea.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy abzatsni PEEL bo‘yicha tuzing: da’vo, izoh, misol va bog‘lash. Bir abzats — bitta asosiy fikr.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapi
board: One idea · a claim, not a fact
Uses a key word from the thesis

examples.t: First, free university education widens access for talented students from poorer families.
examples.uz: Birinchidan, bepul universitet ta’limi kambag‘al oilalardagi iqtidorli talabalar uchun imkoniyatni kengaytiradi.

scenes.say_native: Mavzu gapi abzatsning birinchi gapi. U bitta aniq da’vo qiladi, oddiy fakt emas: “Many students study abroad” fakt, “Free education widens access” esa da’vo, uni izohlash kerak. Shuningdek, tezisdagi kalit so‘zni ishlating, shunda o‘quvchi abzats esse savoliga javob berayotganini ko‘radi. Birinchi abzatsni “First,” bilan, ikkinchisini “Second,” yoki “Another important reason is …” bilan boshlash mumkin.
scenes.say: The topic sentence comes first. It makes one clear claim, not a plain fact, and it repeats a key word from your thesis.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu gapi birinchi keladi. U bitta da’vo qiladi va tezisdagi kalit so‘zni takrorlaydi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy abzats
scenes.say_native: Namunani tahlil qilamiz. Birinchi gap — Point. Ikkinchi gap — Explanation: to‘lovsiz talaba daromadga emas, qobiliyatga qarab tanlaydi. Uchinchi gap — Example: masalan Germaniyada davlat universitetlarida to‘lov juda past. Oxirgi gap — Link: bu butun jamiyatga foyda keltiradi. Diqqat qiling: misolda to‘qilgan raqam yo‘q, faqat umumiy ma’lum fakt. Aniq raqamni bilmasangiz, uydirmang.
scenes.say: First, free tuition widens access for talented students from poorer families. Without fees, they can choose a course because of ability, not income. In Germany, for example, public universities charge very low fees, and many international students study there. This shows that free education benefits the whole society.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchidan, bepul ta’lim iqtidorli talabalar uchun imkoniyatni kengaytiradi. To‘lovsiz ular kursni daromadga emas, qobiliyatga qarab tanlaydi. Masalan, Germaniyada davlat universitetlarida to‘lov juda past va ko‘p xalqaro talabalar o‘qiydi. Bu butun jamiyat foyda ko‘rishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Misol keltirish
board: for example · for instance · such as

examples.t: Many countries, such as Finland, offer free higher education.
examples.uz: Finlandiya kabi ko‘p davlatlar bepul oliy ta’lim taklif qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Misol keltirish iboralari: “for example”, “for instance”, “such as” va “a case in point is …”. Farqi: “for example” gap boshida vergul bilan, “such as” esa gap ichida ro‘yxat oldidan keladi. Dalil uchun “research suggests” yoki “according to” ishlating. Lekin faqat haqiqatan bilgan narsangizni yozing, masalan, o‘z shaxsiy tajribangiz yoki umumiy ma’lum fakt. Uydirma statistika imtihonda ham, hayotda ham obro‘yingizni tushiradi.
scenes.say: For examples, use for example, for instance, such as, or a case in point is. For evidence, say research suggests, but only if it is true.
scenes.say_uz: Misol uchun for example, for instance, such as, a case in point ishlating. Dalil uchun research suggests, faqat haqiqat bo‘lsa.

scenes.title: Abzatsdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Two different ideas in one paragraph
✓ For example, Germany charges very low fees.
scenes.say_native: Abzatsda uch xato bor. Birinchi: bitta abzatsga ikki xil fikr sig‘dirish. Ikkinchi: misol keltirib, uni izohlamaslik: o‘quvchi misol nimani isbotlayotganini bilishi kerak. Uchinchi: “For example, in Germany.” kabi bo‘lak gap. “For example” dan keyin to‘liq gap yoki “such as” bilan ro‘yxat kelishi kerak. To‘g‘ri variant: “For example, Germany charges very low fees.”
scenes.say: Common paragraph mistakes: two ideas in one paragraph, an example with no explanation, and a fragment after for example. Always write a full sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolar: bitta abzatsda ikki fikr, izohsiz misol va for example dan keyin bo‘lak gap. Doim to‘liq gap yozing.

scenes.title: Gaplarni tartibga soling
board: a) This shows that a small change can help everyone.
b) Second, cheaper public transport reduces traffic.
c) For example, a monthly bus pass cut car use in one city.
d) Fewer cars on the road also means cleaner air.
scenes.say_native: Тўртта гап. Gaplarni PEEL tartibida joylang: avval mavzu gapi, keyin izoh, keyin misol, oxirida bog‘lovchi xulosa. Qaysi gap “Second” bilan boshlanayotganiga qarang, u mavzu gapi bo‘ladi. Qaysi gapda “For example” bor, qaysi gapda “This shows”? Gaplarni qog‘ozga a, b, c, d harflari bilan yozib, tartibini belgilang.
scenes.say: Put the four sentences in the right order to form one body paragraph: point, explanation, example, link.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni to‘g‘ri tartibda joylab, bitta abzats hosil qiling: da’vo, izoh, misol, bog‘lash.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Point: b · Explanation: d · Example: c · Link: a
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: b, d, c, a. B — mavzu gapi, d — izoh: kamroq mashina, toza havo. C — misol, a — xulosa-bog‘lovchi gap: kichik o‘zgarish hammaga yordam beradi. Agar tartib boshqacha chiqqan bo‘lsa, “Second” va “This shows” kabi signal so‘zlarga qarang: ular o‘rnini aniq ko‘rsatadi. Bunday signallar o‘quvchiga yo‘l ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: The correct order is b, d, c, a. B is the point, d explains it, c gives the example, and a links back.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri tartib: b, d, c, a. B da’vo, d izoh, c misol, a bog‘lash.

scenes.title: Mavzu gapini yozing
board: Essay: Should companies allow remote work?
Write a topic sentence for the FIRST body paragraph (reason: saves time and money).
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: kompaniyalar uzoqdan ishlashga ruxsat berishi kerakmi? Birinchi asosiy abzats uchun mavzu gapini yozing: uzoqdan ishlash vaqt va pulni tejaydi. Gapni “First,” bilan boshlang, bitta da’vo bo‘lsin va fakt emas, fikr bo‘lsin. Shunda abzatsning qolgan qismi nimaga bag‘ishlanishi birdan ayon bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Write a topic sentence for a body paragraph arguing that remote work saves time and money. Start with First.
scenes.say_uz: Uzoqdan ishlash vaqt va pulni tejaydi, degan abzats uchun mavzu gapini yozing. First bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Javob
board: First, remote work saves employees both time and money.
First, working from home removes the cost and stress of commuting.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin javob: “First, remote work saves employees both time and money.” Bu gapda bitta da’vo bor, kalit so‘z “remote work” tezisdan olingan. “Remote work is common today” esa fakt, bahs uchun yetarli emas. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, shunda ham u da’vo ekanini tekshiring.
scenes.say: A possible topic sentence: First, remote work saves employees both time and money.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin mavzu gapi: Avvalo, uzoqdan ishlash xodimlarning ham vaqtini, ham pulini tejaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: o‘qituvchi bilan reja
board: Student and tutor: planning an essay
Listen: What is the thesis? How many body paragraphs?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘qituvchi va talaba esse rejasini muhokama qilmoqda. Ikki narsaga e’tibor bering: talabaning tezisi nima va nechta asosiy abzats rejalashtirilgan. Oxirida o‘qituvchi xulosa haqida nimadir deydi, shuni ham eshiting. Birinchi tinglashda umumiy ma’noni tushuning, ikkinchisida mayda tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Tutor: So, what is your thesis? Student: Remote work should be encouraged, because it saves time and improves well-being. Tutor: Good. So two body paragraphs, one for each reason? Student: Yes. Then my conclusion will suggest a hybrid model. Tutor: Excellent, that is a fresh idea, not just a repetition.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Xo‘sh, tezisingiz nima? Talaba: Uzoqdan ishlashni rag‘batlantirish kerak, chunki u vaqtni tejaydi va farovonlikni oshiradi. O‘qituvchi: Yaxshi. Demak ikkita asosiy abzats, har sabab uchun bittadan? Talaba: Ha. Xulosada gibrid modelni taklif qilaman. O‘qituvchi: Ajoyib, bu yangi fikr, takror emas.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: talabaning tezisi nima? Ikkinchi: nechta asosiy abzats bo‘ladi? Uchinchi: xulosa nimani taklif qiladi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Dialogdagi so‘zlarni o‘zingiz xotirangizdan qaytaring, kerak bo‘lsa, suhbatni yana tinglang. Javob juda qisqa bo‘lsa ham, to‘liq gap bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Three questions. What is the thesis? How many body paragraphs will there be? What will the conclusion suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Tezis nima? Nechta asosiy abzats bo‘ladi? Xulosa nimani taklif qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Remote work should be encouraged (saves time, improves well-being)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uzoqdan ishlashni rag‘batlantirish kerak, chunki vaqtni tejaydi va farovonlikni oshiradi. Ikkinchi: ikkita asosiy abzats. Uchinchi: gibrid model, ya’ni qisman uydan, qisman ofisdan ishlash. E’tibor bering, o‘qituvchi “not just a repetition” deb xulosada yangi fikr bo‘lishini maqtadi. Bu keyingi bo‘limning asosiy g‘oyasi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: remote work should be encouraged because it saves time and improves well-being. Two: two body paragraphs. Three: a hybrid model.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Uzoqdan ishlashni rag‘batlantirish kerak, chunki vaqtni tejaydi va farovonlikni oshiradi. Ikkita asosiy abzats. Xulosada gibrid model taklif qilinadi.

scenes.title: Abzatslarni bog‘lash
board: However · On the other hand · Nevertheless
scenes.say_native: Abzatslar o‘rtasidagi bog‘lovchi so‘zlar o‘quvchiga yo‘l ko‘rsatadi. Qo‘shish uchun “Moreover” va “In addition”. Qarama-qarshilik uchun “However” va “Nevertheless”. Natija uchun “Therefore” va “Consequently”. Tartib uchun “Firstly”, “Secondly”. Bu so‘zlar odatda gap boshida keladi va undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Muhim: ularni har gapda emas, faqat kerak joyda ishlating.
scenes.say: Linking words show how paragraphs connect. Add with moreover or in addition, contrast with however or nevertheless, and show results with therefore or consequently.
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘lovchi so‘zlar abzatslar o‘rtasidagi aloqani ko‘rsatadi. Qo‘shish: moreover, in addition. Qarama-qarshilik: however, nevertheless. Natija: therefore, consequently.

scenes.title: Mazmunli bog‘lanish
board: Repeat a key word: free education → this approach
Use reference words: this, such, these

examples.t: Free tuition also helps the economy. Such an investment pays for itself.
examples.uz: Bepul ta’lim iqtisodga ham yordam beradi. Bunday sarmoya o‘zini oqlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Eng yaxshi bog‘lanish faqat bog‘lovchi so‘zlar bilan emas. Oldingi fikrga “this”, “such”, “these” bilan ishora qiling: “Such an investment pays for itself”. Yana ko‘prik gap yordam beradi: oldingi abzatsning oxirgi fikrini keyingisining boshiga olib o‘tasiz. Masalan: “Beyond fairness, free education also has economic benefits.” Bunday yozuv avtomatik emas, o‘ylab yozilgan ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: Good links are not only linking words. Repeat a key idea with this, such or these, and use a bridge sentence to move from one paragraph to the next.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi bog‘lanish bog‘lovchi so‘zlardan ko‘proq. Oldingi fikrga this, such, these bilan ishora qiling va ko‘prik gap ishlating.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchilardagi xatolar
board: ✗ Moreover at the start of every sentence
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “On the other hand”, “in the other hand” emas. Ikkinchisi: har gapni “Moreover” bilan boshlash: bu mexanik eshitiladi. Uchinchisi: “At last” — uzoq kutilgan narsa nihoyat bo‘lganda; oxirgi fikrni sanashda “Finally” deyiladi. Shuningdek, “but” va “and” bilan gap boshlash o‘rniga ko‘proq “However” va “In addition” tanlang.
scenes.say: Mistakes with linkers: it is on the other hand, not in the other hand. Do not start every sentence with moreover. And finally, not at last, for the final point.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolar: on the other hand, in the other hand emas. Har gapni moreover bilan boshlamang. Oxirgi fikr uchun at last emas, finally.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi tanlang
board: 1) Cars are convenient. ___, they cause pollution.
2) Fees were cut. ___, more students applied.
scenes.say_native: Uchta bo‘shliq. Birinchi: ikki gap o‘rtasida qarama-qarshilik. Ikkinchi: natija. Uchinchi: qo‘shimcha dalil. Variantlar: However, As a result, In addition. Qaysi biri qayerga mos kelishini baland ovozda ayting. Har bir bog‘lovchidan keyin vergul qo‘yilishini ham unutmang.
scenes.say: Choose a connector for each gap: contrast, result and addition. However, as a result, in addition.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir bo‘shliq uchun bog‘lovchi tanlang: qarama-qarshilik, natija, qo‘shish. However, as a result, in addition.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “However” — qulay, lekin ifloslantiradi, qarama-qarshilik. Ikkinchi: “As a result” — to‘lovlar qisqardi, natijada ko‘proq talaba murojaat qildi. Uchinchi: “In addition” — qo‘shimcha dalil. Uchala holatda ham bog‘lovchidan keyin vergul bor. Agar “However” ni gap o‘rtasida ishlatmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, uni ikki vergul orasiga oling.
scenes.say: Answers. One: however. Two: as a result. Three: in addition.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. However. As a result. In addition.

scenes.title: Xulosaning vazifasi
board: 3. Add a final thought: result, advice or prediction
scenes.say_native: Xulosaning uchta vazifasi bor. Birinchi: pozitsiyangizni yangi so‘zlar bilan qaytarish. Ikkinchi: asosiy fikrlarni qisqa yig‘ish. Uchinchi: oxirgi fikr, ya’ni oqibat, tavsiya yoki bashorat. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: xulosada kirishni so‘zma-so‘z takrorlash. Buning o‘rniga sinonim va boshqa gap tuzilishidan foydalaning. Yangi dalil keltirish ham mumkin emas, chunki uni asoslab bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: A conclusion does three jobs: restates your position in new words, summarises your main points, and leaves the reader with a final thought. It never introduces a new argument.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosaning uch vazifasi bor: pozitsiyani yangi so‘zlar bilan qaytarish, asosiy fikrlarni yig‘ish va oxirgi fikr qoldirish. Yangi dalil keltirilmaydi.

scenes.title: Takrorsiz xulosa
board: Intro: University should be free because it widens opportunity and strengthens the economy.
scenes.say_native: Mana xulosa. “Removing fees” — “free” ning yangi ifodasi, “fairer start” — “widens opportunity”, “benefit the economy” — “strengthens the economy”. Demak, fikr bir xil, so‘zlar boshqa. Oxirgi gap esa yangi: qaror qabul qilmaslikning narxi undan ham yuqori bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu oxirgi fikr, ya’ni tavsiya va ogohlantirish.
scenes.say: In short, removing fees would give talented students a fairer start and benefit the economy in the long term. Governments that hesitate may find that the cost of doing nothing is far greater.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, to‘lovlarni bekor qilish iqtidorli talabalarga adolatliroq start beradi va uzoq muddatda iqtisodga foyda keltiradi. Ikkilanayotgan hukumatlar harakatsizlik narxi ancha yuqori ekanini bilib qolishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Xulosa iboralari
board: In conclusion, … · To sum up, … · Overall, …
Final thought: Governments should / It is time to …
scenes.say_native: Xulosani boshlash uchun iboralar: “In conclusion”, “To sum up”, “Overall”. Kuchliroq variantlar: “On balance” va “All things considered” — hamma narsani hisobga olib. Eslatma: “In conclusion” dan keyin “I think that I …” kabi takror qilmang. Oxirgi gapda esa tavsiya bering: “Governments should …” yoki “It is time to …”. Shunday qilib esse kuchli nuqta bilan tugaydi.
scenes.say: Introduce your conclusion with in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance or all things considered. Then close with a recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosani in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance yoki all things considered bilan boshlang. Keyin tavsiya bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Xulosadagi xatolar
board: ✗ In conclusion, I think that I think …
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: xulosada yangi dalil keltirish: o‘quvchi uni asoslanmagan deb topadi. Ikkinchisi: kirishni so‘zma-so‘z takrorlash: bu qog‘ozni to‘ldirish kabi ko‘rinadi. Uchinchisi: “In conclusion, I think that I believe” kabi ortiqcha takror. Tuzatish: pozitsiyani sinonimlar bilan ayting va oxirida bitta yangi, lekin dalil talab qilmaydigan fikr qo‘shing.
scenes.say: Three conclusion mistakes: adding a new argument, copying the introduction, and repeating I think. Rephrase and add a final thought.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosadagi uch xato: yangi dalil qo‘shish, kirishni ko‘chirish va I think ni takrorlash. Qayta ifodalang va oxirgi fikr qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Xulosa yozing
board: Thesis: Cities should ban cars from centres because it cuts pollution and makes streets safer.
scenes.say_native: Tezis: shaharlar markazdan mashinalarni taqiqlashi kerak, chunki ifloslanish kamayadi va ko‘chalar xavfsizroq bo‘ladi. Ikki gapli xulosa yozing. Gap boshida “In conclusion” yoki “Overall” ishlating, so‘zlarni takrorlamang va oxirida tavsiya bering. Ikkitadan ortiq gap yozmang, qisqalik ham fazilat.
scenes.say: Write a two-sentence conclusion for this thesis. Do not copy the words. Rephrase and finish with a recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Bu tezis uchun ikki gapli xulosa yozing. So‘zlarni ko‘chirmang va tavsiya bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Overall, car-free centres would give cities cleaner air and safer streets.
It is time for councils to put people before traffic.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Overall, car-free centres would give cities cleaner air and safer streets. It is time for councils to put people before traffic.” “Ban” o‘rniga “car-free centres”, “cuts pollution” o‘rniga “cleaner air”, ya’ni sinonimlar. Ikkinchi gap esa tavsiya. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi, so‘zlar ko‘chirilmagan va yangi dalil yo‘q.
scenes.say: A model answer: Overall, car-free centres would give cities cleaner air and safer streets. It is time for councils to put people before traffic.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: Umuman, mashinasiz markazlar shaharlarga toza havo va xavfsizroq ko‘chalar beradi. Kengashlar insonlarni transportdan ustun qo‘yadigan vaqt keldi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy uslub
board: Use I sparingly: I believe, in my view
scenes.say_native: Esseda rasmiy uslubni saqlang. Qisqartmalar yo‘q: “don’t” o‘rniga “do not”. Jargon yo‘q: “kids” o‘rniga “children”. “I” ni kam ishlating, “I believe” yoki “in my view” bir-ikki marta yetarli. Gaplar uzunligini almashtirib turing: qisqa gap fikrni kuchaytiradi, uzun gap izohlaydi. Imtihon nuqtai nazaridan esa so‘z soni muhim: 250 so‘z so‘ralgan bo‘lsa, 230 dan 280 gacha yozing.
scenes.say: Keep a formal register: no contractions, no slang, and use I sparingly. Mix short and long sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy uslubni saqlang: qisqartma va jargon yo‘q, I kam. Gap uzunliklarini almashtiring.

scenes.title: Vaqtni taqsimlash
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda vaqt cheklangan. Taxminiy taqsimot: 5 daqiqa reja, 25 daqiqa yozish, 5 daqiqa tekshirish. Rejasiz yozsangiz, tezis bilan abzatslar mos kelmay qoladi. Tekshirishda to‘rtta narsaga qarang: artikllar, zamonlar, imlo va bog‘lovchi so‘zlar. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘qligi uchun, ayniqsa “a”, “the” ni tekshiring. Bunday qisqa tekshiruv bir necha ballni tejaydi.
scenes.say: Spend five minutes planning, twenty-five writing and five checking. Check articles, tenses, spelling and linking words.
scenes.say_uz: Besh daqiqa rejalashtiring, yigirma besh daqiqa yozing, besh daqiqa tekshiring: artikl, zamon, imlo va bog‘lovchilarni.

scenes.title: Reja tuzing
board: Write: thesis + 2 topic sentences + conclusion idea
scenes.say_native: Savol: uy vazifasini taqiqlash kerakmi? Tezisni, ikkita mavzu gapini va xulosa g‘oyasini yozing. Oldin pozitsiyangizni tanlang, keyin ikki sabab toping. Sabablar bir-biridan farq qilsin va har biri alohida abzatsga yetarli bo‘lsin. Rejani yozishga yarim daqiqa sarflang, keyingi sahnada namunani ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: Make a plan for this essay: Should homework be banned? Write a thesis, two topic sentences and an idea for the conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasini taqiqlash kerakmi? Tezis, ikkita mavzu gapi va xulosa g‘oyasini yozing.

scenes.title: Namuna reja
board: Thesis: Homework should be reduced, not banned, because it builds independence but can harm well-being.
P1: First, homework builds independent study habits.
P2: However, too much of it damages sleep and family time.
Conclusion: A limit, e.g. one hour a night.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy reja: tezis — uy vazifasini taqiqlash emas, kamaytirish kerak. Birinchi abzats: u mustaqillikni rivojlantiradi. Ikkinchi abzats: haddan ko‘pi uyqu va oila vaqtiga zarar beradi. Xulosa: oqilona cheklov. Ko‘ryapsizmi, ikkinchi abzats birinchisi bilan “however” orqali bog‘langan. Sizning rejangiz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, tezis va abzatslar mos kelsa, yaxshi.
scenes.say: A possible plan. Thesis: homework should be reduced, not banned. Paragraph one: it builds independence. Paragraph two: too much damages sleep and family time. Conclusion: set a sensible limit.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy reja. Tezis: uy vazifasini taqiqlash emas, kamaytirish kerak. Birinchi abzats: mustaqillik. Ikkinchi: ortiqchasi uyqu va oilaga zarar. Xulosa: oqilona cheklov.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib tekshirish
board: Stress key words · pause at commas
scenes.say_native: Yozganingizni topshirishdan oldin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Quloq ko‘zdan ko‘ra ko‘proq xatoni topadi: tushib qolgan so‘z, haddan uzun gap, noqulay bog‘lanish. Vergulda biroz to‘xtang, kalit so‘zlarni urg‘u bilan ayting. Artikllar yengil va urg‘usiz talaffuz qilinadi, shuning uchun “a” yoki “the” yetishmayotgan joyda ritm buziladi, shunga quloq soling.
scenes.say: Read your essay aloud before you hand it in. Your ear will catch missing words, long sentences and awkward links that your eyes miss.
scenes.say_uz: Topshirishdan oldin esseni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Quloq tushib qolgan so‘zlarni va noqulay joylarni topadi.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv ro‘yxati
board: Subject–verb agreement: The number of students is …
scenes.say_native: Tekshiruv ro‘yxati. Birinchi: ega va fe’l moslashuvi, masalan “The number of students is”. Ikkinchi: artikllar. Uchinchi: zamonlarni bir xil saqlash, abzats o‘rtasida o‘tgan zamondan hozirgiga sakramang. To‘rtinchi: imlo, ayniqsa “environment”, “necessary”, “separate” kabi so‘zlar. Bu to‘rt narsani tekshirish ko‘pincha bir necha ball qo‘shadi.
scenes.say: Before you finish, run a quick checklist: agreement, articles, tenses and spelling. Words like necessary, separate and environment are often misspelled.
scenes.say_uz: Tezkor ro‘yxat: moslashuv, artikllar, zamonlar va imlo. Environment, necessary, separate so‘zlarida ko‘p xato qilinadi.

scenes.title: Kuchli birinchi gap

examples.t: While many people see homework as essential, others question its value.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik uy vazifasini zarur deb bilsa-da, boshqalar uning qadrini shubha ostiga qo‘yadi.

scenes.say_native: Kirishning birinchi gapi o‘quvchini jalb qilishi kerak. Yaxshi usullardan biri qarama-qarshilik: “While many people see homework as essential, others question its value.” Boshqa usul qisqa savol yoki kam ma’lum fakt. “Nowadays” va “Since ancient times” kabi bo‘sh boshlanishlardan saqlaning, chunki ular hech narsa demaydi va juda ko‘p takrorlanadi.
scenes.say: A strong first sentence can start with a contrast: While many people see homework as essential, others question its value. Avoid empty openers such as nowadays.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi gapni qarama-qarshilik bilan boshlash mumkin. Nowadays kabi bo‘sh boshlanishlardan saqlaning.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Links: however, as a result, this
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: aniq tezis, ya’ni pozitsiya va sabablar. Ikkinchi: abzatsni PEEL bilan tuzing: da’vo, izoh, misol, bog‘lash. Uchinchi: abzatslarni bog‘lovchi so‘zlar va “this”, “such” kabi ishoralar bilan ulang. To‘rtinchi: xulosada pozitsiyani yangi so‘zlar bilan ayting va oxirgi fikr qo‘shing. Endi bularni o‘zingiz yozib sinab ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: To recap: a clear thesis, PEEL paragraphs, links between ideas, and a conclusion in new words with a final thought.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqacha: aniq tezis, PEEL abzatslar, fikrlar orasida bog‘lanish va yangi so‘zlardagi xulosa bilan oxirgi fikr.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Success: thesis + 2 PEEL paragraphs + conclusion, 230-280 words
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda 250 so‘zli fikr bildirish essesini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: aniq tezis, PEEL bo‘yicha ikkita asosiy abzats, takrorsiz xulosa va 230 dan 280 so‘zgacha hajm. Yozib bo‘lgach, artikl, zamon, imlo va bog‘lovchilarni tekshiring. Keyingi darsda talaffuz, ya’ni urg‘u, ohang va so‘zlarning bog‘lanishini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, write a 250-word opinion essay on a topic you choose. Include a clear thesis, two body paragraphs and a conclusion. Check it with the checklist.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: tanlagan mavzuda 250 so‘zli fikr bildirish essesini yozing.

homework_uz: 250 so‘zli fikr bildirish essesini yozing (mavzuni o‘zingiz tanlang). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: aniq tezis, PEEL bo‘yicha ikkita asosiy abzats, takrorsiz xulosa va 230–280 so‘z.

quiz.q: Which is the best thesis statement?
options: Homework should be reduced because it harms sleep and limits family time.
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli tezisda pozitsiya va sabab bor.

quiz.q: Where does the thesis usually appear?
options: In the first sentence of the conclusion
At the end of the introduction
In the middle of paragraph two

quiz.q: In PEEL, what does the second E stand for?

options: In the other hand, cars are convenient.
On the other hand, cars are convenient.
At the other hand, cars are convenient.
On other hand, cars are convenient.
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ri ibora: on the other hand.

options: For example, Finland charges no fees.
For instance, many countries charge fees.
quiz.why_uz: “For example” dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak.

quiz.q: What should a conclusion NOT do?

options: First, banning phones in class improves concentration.
I will talk about phones now.
quiz.why_uz: Mavzu gapi bitta aniq da’vo qilishi kerak.

options: Since the beginning of time, people have studied.
More and more families struggle with the cost of university.
In today's modern world, education exists.
quiz.why_uz: Aniq kontekst beradigan gap klishe emas.

quiz.q: Which is more formal for an essay?
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy uslub: qisqartma va jargon yo‘q.
